statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
There is concern for underlying arrhythmia in the context of a recent transient cerebral ischemic attack
The patient has a history of sick sinus syndrome
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered
The service is to correlate symptomatic events with potential bradyarrhythmic or tachyarrhythmic activity
The diagnosis codes are G45.9, I49.5, and R42
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on required precertification or authorization not being obtained prior to the service date
